description: Price history (OHLC candles) for UP TO 100 Kalshi markets over ONE shared window, in ONE call — Kalshi's batch candlestick endpoint (`GET /markets/candlesticks`). This is the comparison tool: every bucket of a Fed or CPI event on one timeline, or the same question across several strikes, without the N separate calls kalshi_price_history would cost. Per candle: YES open/high/low/close/mean as a probability 0-1, best bid/ask close, volume and open interest. Kalshi caps the response at 10,000 candles ACROSS all markets combined — when the cap binds the response says `truncated_by_upstream: true` and tells you which tickers came back short, because a silently halved series is indistinguishable from a quiet market. For ONE ticker with paging, a longer window, or a market old enough that Kalshi has archived it, use kalshi_price_history: this batch endpoint has no archive fallback and no cursor.

end_ts.description: Window END — same formats. Defaults to now.

interval.description: "1h" (hourly, default) | "1d" (daily) | "1m" (per-minute). Kalshi accepts only these three; the 10,000-candle cap is shared across every ticker you ask for, so a per-minute window over 100 markets will bind it.

lookback_days.description: Sugar for a window ending now (1-365, default 1). Ignored when both start_ts and end_ts are given.

start_ts.description: Window START — ISO date ("2026-09-01"), ISO datetime, or unix seconds.

tickers.description: Market tickers, 1-100 (e.g. ["KXHIGHNY-26SEP16-B75.5","KXHIGHNY-26SEP16-B77.5"]). A comma-separated string is accepted too.

name: kalshi_candlesticks
title: Kalshi Candlesticks
